# Woodkari Exports

> Woodkari Exports, Sambhal, Uttar Pradesh. Wooden and resin trays and boxes, making since 2008. Bulk orders from 25 pieces; single pieces on WhatsApp.

Woodkari is a workshop in India, at work since 2008. Four karigars cut the wood on a CNC router, engrave by laser and finish our wooden pieces by hand. Our resin trays are made with other makers near our workshop.

Bulk is most of our work. Hotels, gifting companies, shops and importers can order our trays and boxes from 25 pieces of a design, and the acacia pieces in any size.

Pictures marked "Made to order" or "Styled picture" are made to show the look of a piece; wood grain and resin differ a little on every piece. Only pictures marked "plain photo" are photos of our own pieces.

## Made to order designs, by kind

- [Acacia wood, made to order](https://woodkariexports.com/designs.html#g-acacia): Trays, a bowl, a serving board, a coaster set and candle stands. Acacia wood; other woods on request. Each design shows its size; other sizes on request.
- [Painted trays and bowls](https://woodkariexports.com/designs.html#g-painted): Wooden trays, bowls and boards with a painted (meena) design.
- [Resin bathroom sets](https://woodkariexports.com/designs.html#g-bath): Soap dispenser, tumbler, tray and more, in resin.
- [Resin bowls and platters](https://woodkariexports.com/designs.html#g-bowls): Bowls, platters and salad servers in resin.
- [Wooden boards](https://woodkariexports.com/designs.html#g-boards): Chopping and serving boards, engraved by laser or with a resin pour.
- [Candle stands](https://woodkariexports.com/designs.html#g-candles): Wooden tealight holders and candle stands.
- [Inlay chests](https://woodkariexports.com/designs.html#g-chests): Chests of drawers and bedside chests with an inlay design.

## Bulk terms (from the bulk page)

- Minimum: Trays and boxes: 25 pieces of one design. Small pieces such as coasters and tissue boxes: larger lots, ask us
- Size: Acacia pieces in any size
- Name or logo: By laser, from 50 pieces of one design
- Making time: Wooden pieces: about 10 to 15 days for 100. Resin pieces: we tell you
- Payment: 50% advance to start the order
- Delivery: At the buyer's cost, quoted before dispatch
